runs.text: Two mothers die for every hundred thousand births. That is the lowest on this chart. Which country is it? Maternal deaths per hundred thousand <<ˈ|l|ɪ|v>> births, since nineteen ninety. Lowest first. In nineteen ninety, Egypt and Iran lose a hundred and seven. Britain leads with six. America, twelve. Israel, twenty nine. Then the region falls fast. Egypt ends at seventeen. Turkey, from forty two to fifteen. Lebanon and Iran end at fifteen and sixteen. America goes the other way. Twelve, then seventeen. twenty twenty one, the pandemic, spikes almost everywhere. Jordan hits seventy nine. Saudi Arabia ends at seven. Germany, four. The UAE, three. Why did America go backwards? Tell me in the comments. And the lowest on the chart? Israel. Two.
